name: swissyphus
display_name: Swissyphus — The AI gateway to Switzerland 🇨🇭
description: Swissyphus — The AI gateway to Switzerland. Zero-key MCP server for Swiss public data: companies, transport, weather, hydrology, geodata, law, statistics, parliament, avalanche, snow, earthquakes, exchange rates, holidays and more. Source attribution on every response.
long_description: One MCP server for 40+ official Swiss open-data sources and the federal catalogues behind them — opendata.swiss datasets (queryable contents), ~900 geo.admin.ch layers, every BFS STAT-TAB table, LINDAS statistical cubes, SBB/Swiss Post/cantonal portals, companies, UID/VAT, court decisions, transport, shared mobility, weather, hydrology, law, parliament, voting, alerts, avalanche, snow, earthquakes, energy, SNB data and more — with find_data to search every catalogue at once. Zero API keys, and every response carries source attribution, licence and freshness metadata. Runs fully locally over stdio.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search the Swiss commercial register (ZEFIX, 700k+ entities) by company name. Returns UID, legal form, seat, status and a link to the cantonal register excerpt. Also accepts a UID like 'CHE-123.456.789' as query.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Full ZEFIX record for one company: purpose, translations, seat, status, legal form, SOGC date and register links. Identify the company by UID ('CHE-107.028.276'), exact name, or EHRAID number.

tools.name: list_legal_forms
tools.description: List the legal-form codes used in the Swiss commercial register (AG, GmbH, foundation, …).

tools.name: list_cantons
tools.description: All 26 Swiss cantons with their two-letter abbreviations (used as filters across Swissyphus tools).

tools.name: search_sogc_publications
tools.description: Search official Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce (SOGC/SHAB) publications: commercial-register mutations (HR), bankruptcies (KK), debt enforcement, and more. Filter by keyword, rubric and date range.

tools.name: get_connections
tools.description: Find the next train/bus/tram/boat connections between two Swiss stations or addresses, with platforms, delays, transfers and per-leg details.

tools.name: get_departures
tools.description: Live departure board for a Swiss public transport station, with delays and platforms.

tools.name: get_arrivals
tools.description: Live arrival board for a Swiss public transport station.

tools.name: search_stations
tools.description: Search Swiss public transport stations and stops by name.

tools.name: get_nearby_stations
tools.description: Find public transport stations near a WGS84 point, sorted by distance.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Official MeteoSwiss current conditions, 8-day forecast and active weather warnings for a Swiss postal code.

tools.name: get_weather_warnings
tools.description: Active MeteoSwiss weather warnings (wind, thunderstorms, heat, snow, flood, forest fire…) for a Swiss postal code, with danger levels 1–5.

tools.name: get_current_measurements
tools.description: Live 10-minute measurements from the official MeteoSwiss (SwissMetNet) station network. Choose a parameter and optionally filter to stations near a point or by name.

tools.name: get_weather_history
tools.description: Historical measurements from an official SwissMetNet station over a date range (recent weeks). Station codes are 3-letter MeteoSwiss codes, e.g. 'SMA' Zürich-Fluntern, 'BER' Bern, 'GVE' Geneva — see get_current_measurements station IDs. Data is downsampled to stay compact.

tools.name: get_pollen
tools.description: Live hourly pollen concentrations from the official MeteoSwiss pollen monitoring network. Choose a taxon (grasses, birch, ash, alder, hazel, mugwort, ambrosia); optionally sort stations by distance from a point.

tools.name: list_weather_stations
tools.description: List official SwissMetNet stations reporting a given parameter, with coordinates and altitude.

tools.name: get_water_data
tools.description: Latest water level, discharge and temperature for a FOEN hydrology station. Use the numeric station ID (e.g. 2099 = Aare Bern, 2243 = Rhône Geneva, 2606 = Lake Zurich). If you don't know the ID, call list_hydro_stations first.

tools.name: get_water_history
tools.description: Historical water level, discharge or temperature for a FOEN station over a date range (recent weeks). Data is downsampled to stay compact.

tools.name: list_hydro_stations
tools.description: List FOEN river/lake monitoring stations with their IDs and water bodies. Optionally filter by name (river, lake or place).

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Search Swiss addresses, places, municipalities and postal codes and return coordinates (WGS84 + LV95). Works with street addresses ('Bundesplatz 3 Bern'), place names ('Matterhorn'), and PLZ codes.

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: Find the nearest registered building/address for WGS84 coordinates using the federal Register of Buildings and Dwellings (GWR). Returns street, number, postal code, locality, municipality and EGID.

tools.name: get_elevation
tools.description: Return the terrain elevation in metres above sea level for WGS84 coordinates in Switzerland.

tools.name: get_elevation_profile
tools.description: Compute a terrain elevation profile along a line of WGS84 points (e.g. a hike). Returns distance/elevation pairs plus total ascent and descent.

tools.name: get_municipality
tools.description: Return the Swiss municipality (Gemeinde) containing the given WGS84 point, including its official BFS number and canton.

tools.name: get_solar_potential
tools.description: Return the federal Sonnendach solar-energy suitability of the roof(s) at the given WGS84 coordinates: suitability class, irradiation, roof area, orientation and slope.

tools.name: identify_map_layers
tools.description: Power tool: query any federal geodata layer(s) at a WGS84 point (e.g. 'ch.bafu.laerm-strassenlaerm_tag' for road noise, 'ch.bafu.gefahren-basiskarte' hazards, 'ch.are.bauzonen' building zones). Returns raw attributes per matching feature.

tools.name: convert_wgs84_to_lv95
tools.description: Convert WGS84 latitude/longitude to Swiss LV95 coordinates (EPSG:2056). Also returns legacy LV03 values.

tools.name: convert_lv95_to_wgs84
tools.description: Convert Swiss LV95 coordinates (EPSG:2056, easting ~2'600'000 / northing ~1'200'000) to WGS84 latitude/longitude. LV03 legacy values (600'000/200'000 range) are auto-detected and shifted.

tools.name: lookup_postcode
tools.description: Resolve a 4-digit Swiss postal code (PLZ/NPA) to its locality/localities with coordinates.

tools.name: search_locality
tools.description: Search Swiss localities by name in the official directory and return their postal code(s).

tools.name: track_parcel
tools.description: Generate the official Swiss Post tracking URL for a shipment number (parcels, registered mail). Returns the link — tracking status itself requires the Swiss Post site.

tools.name: get_building
tools.description: Official GWR/RegBL record for a building identified by its federal EGID: status, category, construction year, floors, dwelling count, area, heating info. Get the EGID from reverse_geocode.

tools.name: search_federal_law
tools.description: Search the Swiss Classified Compilation (SR/RS) of federal law by title or abbreviation (e.g. 'data protection', 'OR', 'Datenschutz'). Returns SR number, title, abbreviation and the official Fedlex link. Search in the language of your query term (German titles for German terms, etc.).

tools.name: get_law_by_sr
tools.description: Look up one act of the Classified Compilation by its SR number (e.g. '220' Code of Obligations, '235.1' Data Protection Act). Returns titles in all official languages, in-force status and Fedlex links.

tools.name: search_international_treaties
tools.description: Search international treaties and agreements binding Switzerland (the international part of the Classified Compilation, SR numbers starting '0.': bilateral agreements with the EU, double-taxation agreements, conventions, UN/Council of Europe treaties) by title keyword and/or SR area. Returns SR number, title, short title, entry-into-force date, in-force status and the Fedlex link. Titles are language-specific: {query:'Doppelbesteuerung'} (de), {query:'double imposition', language:'fr'}, {query:'Freizügigkeit'}, {sr_prefix:'0.142.11'} (EU free movement area).

tools.name: list_recent_legislation_changes
tools.description: What changed in Swiss federal law in a date range (Classified Compilation): 'amended' = acts for which a new consolidated version became applicable (amendments taking effect, incl. new acts), 'entered_into_force' = acts that entered into force, 'repealed' = acts that ceased to be in force. Returns date, SR number, title and Fedlex link, newest first. Dates may lie in the future to see scheduled changes. Examples: {} (amendments in the last 30 days); {change:'entered_into_force', date_from:'2025-01-01', date_to:'2025-01-31'}; {sr_prefix:'8', query:'Kranken'} (health law).

tools.name: search_federal_gazette
tools.description: Search publications in the Federal Gazette (Bundesblatt BBl / Feuille fédérale FF / Foglio federale FF): Federal Council dispatches (Botschaften) on new bills, draft federal acts and decrees, referendum texts, reports and official notices. Filter by title keyword and publication-date range; returns date, title, BBl reference (e.g. 'BBl 2024 1234') and Fedlex link, newest first. Examples: {query:'Botschaft'}; {query:'Klima', date_from:'2023-01-01'}; {query:'énergie', language:'fr'}.

tools.name: get_population
tools.description: Official permanent resident population (BFS STATPOP) for Switzerland and every canton, latest available year. Optionally filter to one canton by name.

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Full-text search over the national open-data catalogue opendata.swiss (default) or the City of Zürich portal (portal='stadt-zuerich'): statistics (population, prices, energy…), geodata, transport, health and more. Each hit lists its resource formats and whether it is queryable (has CSV/JSON/GeoJSON). Filter by publisher (slug from list_data_publishers), by format (e.g. 'CSV'), sort by 'modified' for the newest. Then call query_dataset {id} for the actual rows, or get_dataset {id} for metadata. Examples: {query: 'Mietpreisindex'}, {query: 'Bevölkerung Gemeinde', format: 'CSV'}, {publisher: 'bundesamt-fur-statistik-bfs', sort: 'modified'}, {query: 'Velo', portal: 'stadt-zuerich'}.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Full metadata for one dataset on opendata.swiss (or portal='stadt-zuerich'): description, publisher, licence and every resource with its 0-based index, format, whether it is queryable by query_dataset, and its direct download link.

tools.name: query_dataset
tools.description: Fetch the actual data of an opendata.swiss / City of Zürich dataset and return matching rows. Picks the best machine-readable resource (CSV > JSON > GeoJSON; HTML landing pages, ZIP, XLSX, PDF and services are skipped and reported with their download URLs), parses it and applies search / column filters / sort / paging. Returns columns, total matched, rows, the resource used and its licence. Works with a dataset id or a direct resource_url. Run describe_dataset_columns first to learn column names and values. Examples: {id: '<dataset-id>', where: {Kanton: 'ZH'}, sort: '-Einwohner', limit: 10}; {id: '<dataset-id>', search: 'Winterthur', columns: ['Jahr','Wert']}; {resource_url: 'https://…/data.csv', where: {Jahr: '>2020'}}.

tools.name: describe_dataset_columns
tools.description: Fetch and parse a dataset's best CSV/JSON/GeoJSON resource (or a direct resource_url) and return its row count and, per column, the detected type (number/string/mixed), non-null count and example values — use it to plan query_dataset filters or aggregate_dataset group-bys. Examples: {id: '<dataset-id>'} or {id: '<dataset-id>', portal: 'stadt-zuerich', resource: '1'}.

tools.name: aggregate_dataset
tools.description: Group a dataset's rows by one or two columns and compute count, sum, avg, min or max of a numeric column (after optional where/search filters) — e.g. total population per canton, average rent per year. Numbers with Swiss formatting (1'234.5) are understood. Examples: {id: '<dataset-id>', group_by: ['Kanton'], op: 'sum', value_column: 'Einwohner'}; {id: '<dataset-id>', group_by: ['Jahr','Kanton'], op: 'avg', value_column: 'Wert', where: {Jahr: '>2015'}, order: 'group'}; {id: '<dataset-id>', group_by: ['Kategorie'], op: 'count'}.

tools.name: list_data_publishers
tools.description: List the organisations publishing on opendata.swiss (federal offices, cantons, cities, companies) or on the City of Zürich portal (departments), with their slug and dataset count. Use the slug as 'publisher' in search_datasets. Examples: {} (largest publishers first), {query: 'statistik'}, {query: 'Kanton Zürich', lang: 'de'}, {portal: 'stadt-zuerich'}.

tools.name: search_parliament_business
tools.description: Search Curia Vista for federal parliamentary business (motions, postulates, interpellations, bills) by title keyword. Returns business number, type, status and submission date.

tools.name: get_parliament_business
tools.description: Details of a specific Curia Vista business by its numeric ID (e.g. 20230456 → ID from search).

tools.name: get_session_schedule
tools.description: Recent and upcoming sessions of the Federal Assembly with dates and names.

tools.name: get_parliament_votes
tools.description: Formal council votes for a parliamentary business (by short number like '23.4567'), including the subject, what yes/no meant, and the actual yes/no/abstain tallies of the most recent vote.

tools.name: search_council_members
tools.description: Search current members of the National Council and Council of States by name, canton or party.

tools.name: search_parliament_speeches
tools.description: Search the verbatim record of speeches in the National Council and Council of States (Amtliches Bulletin transcripts) by speaker and/or keyword, optionally within a date range or session. Returns speaker, function, parliamentary group, canton, council, date, the business debated (short number + title when resolvable), a plain-text excerpt centred on the keyword, and a link to the official Bulletin debate. Keyword matching is case-sensitive and matches the speech's original language (e.g. 'Klimaschutz', 'Neutralität', 'intelligence artificielle'). Examples: {speaker:'Noser', keyword:'Datenschutz'}; {keyword:'Kita', date_from:'2024-01-01'}; {person_number:4057}. Speaker names come from search_council_members.

tools.name: get_member_interests
tools.description: Lobbying transparency: the declared interests and mandates of a member of the Federal Assembly (board seats, advisory roles, associations, foundations) with the organisation, the member's function, the type of interest and organisation, and paid/unpaid where published — plus declared occupations. Look up by last name (e.g. 'Noser', optionally first_name) or exact person_number (ID from search_council_members). Examples: {name:'Bregy'}; {name:'Müller', first_name:'Damian'}; {person_number:4057}.

tools.name: list_parliament_committees
tools.description: List committees of the Federal Assembly (legislative committees such as WAK-N/WAK-S economy, SiK security, UREK environment, SGK health, plus supervisory committees GPK/FinK and joint bodies). Returns committee number, name, abbreviation, council (NR/SR/BV) and type. Filter by council and a name/abbreviation fragment. Examples: {council:'NR'}; {query:'Wirtschaft'}; {query:'SGK'}. Use get_committee_members for the members.

tools.name: get_committee_members
tools.description: Current members of one Federal Assembly committee with their function (president, vice-president, member), party, parliamentary group, canton and council. Identify the committee by abbreviation ('WAK-N', 'SGK-S', 'GPK-N'), committee number, or a name fragment ('Wirtschaft und Abgaben'). Use list_parliament_committees to find committees.

tools.name: list_parliamentary_groups
tools.description: Current parliamentary groups (Fraktionen: e.g. SVP-Fraktion, SP, Mitte, FDP, Grüne, GLP) or parties with their seat counts in the National Council (NR) and Council of States (SR), computed from the active membership. For groups, a party breakdown is included; for parties, the group they sit with. Examples: {} (factions, both chambers); {by:'party', council:'SR'}.

tools.name: list_vote_dates
tools.description: List available federal popular-vote days with official result data (newest first).

tools.name: get_voting_results
tools.description: Official results of federal popular votes for a vote day (default: most recent): national yes-share, turnout, accepted/rejected, cantonal majority, and optional per-canton breakdown.

tools.name: get_emergency_alerts
tools.description: All currently active Alertswiss population warnings for Switzerland: event type, severity, affected regions, official instructions. Optionally filter by a region/canton keyword.

tools.name: get_avalanche_bulletin
tools.description: The current official SLF avalanche bulletin for Switzerland: danger ratings per warning region (EAWS scale 1 low – 5 very high). Outside winter the bulletin is empty and this tool reports that clearly.

tools.name: get_avalanche_danger_at
tools.description: Avalanche danger level for a specific WGS84 point (e.g. a ski-touring destination), resolved against the SLF warning-region polygons.

tools.name: list_snow_stations
tools.description: List SLF IMIS high-alpine measurement stations with code, name, elevation and coordinates. Filter by canton or name, or sort by distance from a point.

tools.name: get_snow_conditions
tools.description: Latest measurements (snow depth, temperatures, wind) from IMIS stations. Filter by station code (from list_snow_stations) or get the deepest-snow stations right now.

tools.name: get_trail_closures
tools.description: Current official hiking-trail closures and detours within a radius of a WGS84 point (default 20 km). Use before recommending any hike.

tools.name: get_recent_earthquakes
tools.description: The most recent seismic events recorded by the Swiss Seismological Service, newest first. Optionally filter by minimum magnitude.

tools.name: get_earthquake_details
tools.description: Full record for one seismic event by its SED event ID (the event_id returned by get_recent_earthquakes).

tools.name: search_earthquakes
tools.description: Search historical seismic events near a WGS84 point within a radius, with optional date range and magnitude filter.

tools.name: list_air_quality_stations
tools.description: All stations of the national NABEL air pollution monitoring network with type, altitude, coordinates and links to live hourly data. Optionally sorted by distance from a point.

tools.name: get_air_quality
tools.description: NABEL station details (nearest to a point or by name) together with the Swiss legal ambient limit values (LRV/OAPC) for PM10, PM2.5, NO2, O3, SO2 and CO, plus the link to live hourly measurements.

tools.name: get_electricity_tariff
tools.description: Official ElCom electricity tariff for a Swiss municipality, broken into energy, grid usage, community charges and federal grid surcharge (Rp./kWh). Categories: H1–H8 households (H4 = typical 4-room flat), C1–C7 commercial.

tools.name: compare_electricity_tariffs
tools.description: Compare official electricity tariffs (total Rp./kWh, standard product) across up to 10 Swiss municipalities for one category and year.

tools.name: get_ev_chargers_nearby
tools.description: EV charging stations from the national ich-tanke-strom.ch dataset near WGS84 coordinates: operator, plugs, power, 24h access, address. Sorted by distance.

tools.name: get_exchange_rate
tools.description: Latest official SNB exchange rate for a currency against CHF (monthly average, e.g. EUR, USD, GBP, JPY). Rates are 'CHF per N units of foreign currency'.

tools.name: get_exchange_rate_history
tools.description: Monthly average CHF exchange-rate history for a currency over a month range (YYYY-MM).

tools.name: list_currencies
tools.description: List all currencies for which the SNB publishes official CHF exchange rates.

tools.name: list_snb_datasets
tools.description: Curated list of well-known Swiss National Bank data-portal cube ids (FX rates, money market rates incl. SARON, Confederation bond yields, SNB balance sheet, monetary aggregates, CPI, effective exchange rates) with frequency and a confidence flag for each id. Optional keyword filter, e.g. 'saron', 'bond yield', 'balance sheet', 'M3'. Then call get_snb_cube_dimensions or get_snb_data with the cube_id. Any other cube id from data.snb.ch also works with those tools.

tools.name: get_snb_cube_dimensions
tools.description: List the dimensions of any SNB data-portal cube and the item ids in each (e.g. devkum: D0 = monthly average 'M0' / end of month 'M1', D1 = currency 'EUR1', 'USD1', 'JPY100', …). Use the ids in get_snb_data's dimension_selection to fetch only the series you need. Examples: cube_id='devkum', cube_id='zimoma'.

tools.name: get_snb_data
tools.description: Fetch labelled time series from any Swiss National Bank data-portal cube: each series has its dimension labels, unit, scale and the most recent values (trimmed to values_per_series). Optional date range (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD matching the cube frequency) and dimension_selection from get_snb_cube_dimensions, e.g. {"D0":["M0"],"D1":["EUR1","USD1"]}. Examples: cube_id='zimoma' (money market rates incl. SARON), cube_id='devkum', from_date='2024-01'.

tools.name: get_public_holidays
tools.description: Public holidays in Switzerland for a year, optionally scoped to a canton (two-letter code). Includes nationwide and cantonal holidays.

tools.name: get_school_holidays
tools.description: School holiday periods for a Swiss canton and year.

tools.name: is_holiday_today
tools.description: Check whether today (or a given date) is a public holiday in a canton or nationwide.

tools.name: get_waste_collection
tools.description: Upcoming waste and recycling collection dates for a Zürich-region ZIP code. Types: waste (household), cardboard, paper, organic (green), special, textile, metal, cargotram, etram, glass.

tools.name: list_waste_types
tools.description: All waste/recycling collection types supported by the waste calendar.

tools.name: get_swiss_news
tools.description: Latest Swiss news headlines from SRF with links and publication times. Optionally filter by keyword. Returns metadata + links only (the full article stays at the source, per licence).

tools.name: query_lindas
tools.description: Run a read-only SPARQL SELECT query against lindas.admin.ch, the Swiss federal linked-data service. Useful graphs include <https://lindas.admin.ch/elcom/electricityprice> (energy prices), ELI legislation, the municipality register (ld.admin.ch/municipality/{BFS}), and cube.link statistical cubes. A LIMIT of 100 is enforced if none is given.

tools.name: list_data_portals
tools.description: Registry of Swiss open-data portals that run on Opendatasoft and can be searched/queried with search_portal_datasets, get_portal_dataset and query_portal_records: SBB (data.sbb.ch — station passenger frequency, rolling stock, actual train times), Swiss Post (postcodes, street directory, post office / PostBus locations), Basel-Stadt (real-time parking, Rhine temperature, air quality, elections), Basel-Landschaft, Canton & City of St. Gallen, Thurgau. Returns id, name, operator, domain, licence note, platform confidence and what each portal is good for.

tools.name: search_portal_datasets
tools.description: Full-text search of dataset catalogues on SBB, Swiss Post and cantonal/city Opendatasoft portals — one portal or all in parallel (per-portal errors are reported, not fatal). Returns portal, dataset_id, title, short description, record count, last-modified date and themes; pass portal + dataset_id to get_portal_dataset / query_portal_records. Examples: {query:'passagierfrequenz', portal:'sbb'} (passengers per station), {query:'rollmaterial', portal:'sbb'}, {query:'Parkhaus'} (real-time parking), {query:'Rhein Temperatur', portal:'basel-stadt'}, {query:'Postleitzahl', portal:'swisspost'}, {query:'Wahlen'}. Metadata is mostly German — use German terms. Omit query (with a portal) to list its most recently modified datasets.

tools.name: get_portal_dataset
tools.description: Schema and metadata of one dataset on a Swiss Opendatasoft portal (SBB, Swiss Post, Basel, St. Gallen, Thurgau…): fields (name, label, type, description, facet), record count, licence, publisher, attributions, themes, last modified, and the geo_point field usable for radius search. Call this before query_portal_records to learn field names for where/select/order_by. Example: {portal:'sbb', dataset_id:'passagierfrequenz'}.

tools.name: query_portal_records
tools.description: Fetch records from a dataset on a Swiss Opendatasoft portal with ODSQL: where (e.g. "kanton = 'BS'", "jahr >= 2020", "search(name, 'Bahnhof')"), select (e.g. 'bahnhof_haltestelle, dtv, jahr'), order_by (e.g. 'dtv desc'), group_by with aggregates (select 'kanton, count(*) as n, sum(dtv) as total', group_by 'kanton'), limit/offset. Convenience `near` {lat, lon, radius_m} finds the dataset's geo_point_2d field and returns only records within the radius, sorted by distance (e.g. parking garages within 800 m of Basel SBB: portal 'basel-stadt', near {lat:47.5476, lon:7.5896, radius_m:800}). Real-time datasets (parking occupancy, SBB data) are cached only 10 min. Get field names first with get_portal_dataset.

tools.name: get_shared_vehicles_nearby
tools.description: Live shared-mobility availability near WGS84 coordinates from sharedmobility.ch (SFOE national aggregator: PubliBike, Donkey Republic, Bolt, Voi, Tier, Mobility car sharing, carvelo cargo bikes, …). Returns free-floating vehicles and docking stations (with vehicles/docks available) sorted by distance, each with provider name, vehicle types, distance_m and battery range where published. Filter with vehicle_type: bike | e-bike | cargo_bike | scooter | moped | car. Example: {lat: 47.3779, lon: 8.5403, radius_m: 300, vehicle_type: 'scooter'} (Zürich HB). Use geocode first to turn an address into coordinates.

tools.name: list_shared_mobility_providers
tools.description: All bike/e-bike/e-scooter/moped/car/cargo-bike sharing providers in the sharedmobility.ch national aggregator: provider_id, name, vehicle types, website, Android/iOS app links, and pricing plans where published. Filter by name substring (query: 'publibike') or vehicle_type ('car'). Provider names match the 'provider' field of get_shared_vehicles_nearby.

tools.name: get_transport_disruptions
tools.description: Current and planned disruptions on Swiss public transport (trains, trams, buses, boats) from opentransportdata.swiss service alerts: title, description, cause/effect, validity periods, affected operators/lines/stops. Filter by free text (text: 'Bauarbeiten'), operator (agency id like '11' for SBB, or name), or station (name or UIC number, e.g. 'Olten' or '8500218'). Requires the server env var OPENTRANSPORTDATA_API_KEY (free key); otherwise returns instructions. Example: {station: 'Luzern', lang: 'de'}.

tools.name: get_realtime_delays
tools.description: Realtime arrival/departure delays and cancellations at one Swiss station from the national GTFS-RT trip-update feed (opentransportdata.swiss). Input the 7-digit UIC station number (use search_stations to find it; e.g. 8503000 = Zürich HB, 8507000 = Bern). Returns GTFS trip_id/route_id, delay in minutes and status (CANCELED/SKIPPED). Requires env OPENTRANSPORTDATA_API_KEY (free). For line names and platforms prefer get_departures.

tools.name: lookup_uid
tools.description: Look up one entity in the federal UID register (BFS) by its UID — e.g. 'CHE-107.028.276', 'CHE107028276', '107028276' or a VAT number 'CHE-107.028.276 MWST'. Validates the check digit first (offline). Returns name, legal form, address, UID status, VAT register status (registered yes/no, VAT number, entry date) and commercial-register status. Covers ALL UID holders incl. associations, foundations, sole proprietors and public bodies that are not in ZEFIX.

tools.name: search_uid_register
tools.description: Search the federal UID register (BFS) by entity name — covers every UID holder (companies, associations, foundations, sole proprietors, public administrations), not just commercial-register entries. Optionally narrow by canton ('ZH') or postcode ('8001'); these filters are applied to the returned candidates. Returns UID, name, legal form, address, VAT and commercial-register status. Example: name='Pro Natura', name='Gemeinde Köniz'.

tools.name: validate_vat_number
tools.description: Check whether a Swiss VAT number (MWST/TVA/IVA) is valid and active in the federal VAT register via the UID register, e.g. 'CHE-107.028.276 MWST', 'CHE107028276TVA' or '107028276'. Returns valid true/false, the normalised VAT number and (with include_details) the holder's name, address and VAT entry date — use it for supplier/invoice checks.

tools.name: search_court_decisions
tools.description: Full-text search across Swiss court decisions aggregated by entscheidsuche.ch: Federal Supreme Court (BGer/BGE), Federal Administrative Court (BVGer), Federal Criminal Court (BStGer), Federal Patent Court and the courts of all 26 cantons. Returns docket/reference number, decision date, court, canton, title, abstract snippet, matching text excerpts and a link to the decision (PDF/HTML). Query syntax: words are AND-ed; use "quotes" for phrases, | for OR, - to exclude. Examples: query='Mietzins Kündigung' canton='ZH'; query='"Art. 336 OR"' court='BGer' date_from='2020'; query='5A_123/2020'.

tools.name: get_court_decision
tools.description: Fetch one court decision from entscheidsuche.ch by its id (from search_court_decisions, e.g. 'CH_BGer_005_5A-123-2020_2020-06-15'). Returns metadata (reference, date, court, canton, title, abstract), the document link and a plain-text excerpt of the decision (up to ~20 KB).

tools.name: search_wikidata
tools.description: Find Wikidata items (Q-ids) by name — the universal join key for Swiss municipalities, cantons, mountains, lakes, rivers, companies, people and institutions. Returns id, label, description and match. Set swiss_only=true to keep only items whose country (P17) or citizenship (P27) is Switzerland (Q39). Examples: 'Matterhorn', 'Lac Léman', 'Nestlé', 'ETH Zürich', 'Winterthur' (swiss_only=true). Follow up with get_wikidata_entity.

tools.name: get_wikidata_entity
tools.description: Read one Wikidata item by Q-id: labels in de/fr/it/rm/en, description, the key statements with values resolved to labels (instance of, country, located in, coordinates, population, area, elevation, website, inception, headquarters, industry, …; up to max_properties), Swiss identifiers (BFS municipality code P771, HLS/DHS id P902, parliament id P1307), and de/fr/it/rm/en Wikipedia links. Examples: 'Q72' (Zürich), 'Q1374' (Matterhorn), 'Q11943' (ETH Zürich).

tools.name: query_wikidata
tools.description: Run a read-only SPARQL SELECT (or ASK) against the Wikidata Query Service. Prefixes wd:, wdt:, p:, ps:, pq:, rdfs:, schema:, wikibase:, bd: are predefined; use SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "de,fr,en". } for labels. Swiss hooks: wd:Q39 = Switzerland, wdt:P771 = BFS municipality code, wdt:P17 = country, wdt:P131 = located in. Example: SELECT ?m ?mLabel ?bfs WHERE { ?m wdt:P771 ?bfs . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "de". } }. LIMIT 100 is injected when absent; larger LIMITs are clamped to 1000. 60 s timeout.

tools.name: get_swiss_municipality_facts
tools.description: Wikidata facts for a Swiss municipality by name or BFS number (P771): Q-id, labels, canton, population (latest, with date), area km², elevation m, coordinates, postal codes, official website, coat of arms image, HLS/DHS id and Wikipedia link. Examples: bfs_number=261 (Zürich), name='Lugano', name='Val de Bagnes'. For official BFS statistics prefer get_population / get_municipality; use this for the Q-id join key and enrichment.

tools.name: search_bfs_tables
tools.description: Find Federal Statistical Office (BFS) tables on STAT-TAB by keywords: population, births, deaths, migration, tourism overnight stays, crime, students, vehicles, buildings, enterprises and hundreds more. Returns table ids (e.g. 'px-x-0102010000_101') with titles, to pass to get_bfs_table_metadata then query_bfs_table. Titles are in the chosen language, so use matching search terms (e.g. lang='de', query 'Logiernächte Kanton'). Examples: {query:'population commune age'}, {query:'hotel overnight stays', lang:'en'}.

tools.name: browse_bfs_tables
tools.description: List entries of the BFS PXWeb database tree. Without 'path' lists all STAT-TAB databases (at BFS each is one table, id like 'px-x-1003020000_101', with its title); with 'path' lists that node's children (type level/table, text, updated). Use 'filter' to substring-match titles. Examples: {filter:'Wohnbevölkerung', lang:'de'}, {path:'px-x-0102010000_101'}.

tools.name: get_bfs_table_metadata
tools.description: Dimensions of one STAT-TAB table: each variable's code, label, number of values, first values (code + label), which one is time (with range), the default used when unspecified, and the cell count. Pass 'variable' to list (and 'value_filter' to search) all values of one dimension, e.g. to find a commune code. Examples: {table_id:'px-x-0102010000_101'}, {table_id:'px-x-0102010000_101', variable:'Kanton', value_filter:'Bern'}.

tools.name: query_bfs_table
tools.description: Fetch labelled figures from any STAT-TAB table. 'selection' maps variables (code or label, case/accents ignored) to values (codes or labels); '*' = all values, 'latest' / 'latest:5' = last period(s), '2015-2020' = year range. Unspecified variables default to their total (e.g. 'Schweiz', 'Total') or the latest period, and the response lists every default applied. Max 5000 cells per query. Returns rows like {Kanton:'Zürich', value:1605508} plus 'fixed' for single-valued dimensions. Example: {table_id:'px-x-0102010000_101', selection:{Jahr:['latest'], Kanton:['Zürich','Bern'], Geschlecht:['*']}}.

tools.name: search_data_cubes
tools.description: Keyword search over the federal statistical data cubes on LINDAS (the data behind visualize.admin.ch): electricity prices (ElCom), energy statistics (BFE), environment/air/water (BAFU), agriculture (FOAG), traffic counts (ASTRA), population and economy (BFS) and more. Every word must appear (case-insensitive) in the cube's name, description, publisher or IRI, in any language (German terms often match best, e.g. 'Strompreis', 'Luft', 'Verkehr'). Returns cube IRI, name, trimmed description, publisher, last-modified date and a visualize.admin.ch link. Deprecated cube versions are excluded; published cubes shown on visualize.admin.ch rank first. Next step: describe_data_cube {cube: <IRI>}. Examples: {query: 'electricity price'}, {query: 'Treibhausgas', lang: 'de'}, {query: 'bfe energie', limit: 10}.

tools.name: describe_data_cube
tools.description: Show the structure of one LINDAS statistical cube so you can query it: title, publisher, licence, status, dates, and every dimension with its IRI, label, role (key dimension vs measure), unit, datatype, min/max, and up to N example values with labels (sampled from the cube's value lists and observations). Use the dimension labels and example value labels as filters in query_data_cube. Example: {cube: 'https://energy.ld.admin.ch/elcom/electricityprice'}, {cube: '<IRI from search_data_cubes>', examples: 20, lang: 'de'}.

tools.name: query_data_cube
tools.description: Fetch observations from a LINDAS statistical cube as flat rows keyed by dimension labels (IRI values replaced by their human labels; numbers as numbers). Optional filters map a dimension (label, IRI or IRI local name) to one value or a list of values (label, literal such as a year, or IRI) — matching is exact and case-insensitive; get valid values from describe_data_cube. Returns columns (with role and unit), rows and row_count. limit default 100, max 1000 (large results are trimmed to fit 50 KB). Examples: {cube: 'https://energy.ld.admin.ch/elcom/electricityprice', filters: {'Period': '2025', 'Category': 'H4'}, limit: 50}, {cube: '<IRI>', filters: {'Canton': ['Zürich', 'Bern']}}.

tools.name: search_map_layers
tools.description: Full-text search over the ~900 federal map layers on geo.admin.ch (noise, natural hazards, radon, zoning, protected areas, energy, transport, geology, …). Returns layer ids (e.g. 'ch.bafu.laerm-strassenlaerm_tag') with titles. Next: get_layer_info for fields/metadata, or query_layer_at_point to read values at a location. Examples: query='Strassenlärm', 'radon', 'Grundwasserschutz', 'solar', 'Bauzonen'.

tools.name: get_layer_info
tools.description: Describe one geo.admin.ch layer: title, abstract, data owner, whether it is queryable (identify/find work), time-enabled, attribute fields (name/alias/type + sample values) and legend/map links. Use before find_layer_features (to pick a search field) or to interpret query_layer_at_point attributes. Example: layer_id='ch.bag.radonkarte'.

tools.name: query_layer_at_point
tools.description: Read the attributes of any federal map layers at a WGS84 location: point-in-polygon (radius_m=0), everything within a radius in metres (e.g. antennas within 300 m), or everything inside a bbox. Up to 15 layers per call; results grouped per layer, with per-layer errors isolated if a layer id is bad. Examples: layers='ch.bafu.laerm-strassenlaerm_tag,ch.bag.radonkarte', lat=46.948, lon=7.4474; layers='ch.bakom.standorte-mobilfunkanlagen', radius_m=300, return_geometry=true. Use search_map_layers to find layer ids; for a ready-made multi-layer summary use get_location_report.

tools.name: find_layer_features
tools.description: Attribute search within one geo.admin.ch layer (MapServer/find): returns features whose field contains (or equals) the text. Examples: layer_id='ch.bfs.gebaeude_wohnungs_register', search_field='egid', search_text='1231641', contains=false; layer_id='ch.bafu.bundesinventare-bln', search_field='bln_name', search_text='Aletsch'. Use get_layer_info to see field names.

tools.name: get_layer_feature
tools.description: Fetch the full attributes of one or more features of a geo.admin.ch layer by feature id (ids come from query_layer_at_point or find_layer_features). Example: layer_id='ch.bfs.gebaeude_wohnungs_register', feature_id='1231641_0'. Up to 10 comma-separated ids.

tools.name: get_location_report
tools.description: One-call location due-diligence: geocodes an address (or takes lat/lon) and queries ~20 curated federal layers in parallel — municipality & postcode, registered buildings (GWR), building zone, public-transport quality class, road & rail noise day/night, radon, surface-runoff flooding, seismic subsoil class, groundwater protection zones, contaminated sites, mobile antennas within 300 m, ISOS townscape, BLN landscape, roof solar suitability and district heating networks. Each layer reports status match/no_match/error independently. Examples: address='Bundesplatz 3, Bern'; lat=47.3769, lon=8.5417, topics=['noise','hazards'].

tools.name: search_geodata_collections
tools.description: Keyword search over the downloadable federal geodata collections on data.geo.admin.ch (STAC): swisstopo elevation/imagery/maps, BAFU/BFE/ARE datasets and MeteoSwiss open data — e.g. 'ch.meteoschweiz.ogd-smn' (SwissMetNet automatic weather stations), 'ch.meteoschweiz.ogd-nime' (manual precipitation), 'ch.meteoschweiz.ogd-pollen'. Returns collection ids, titles, licence, providers and time extent. Next: get_geodata_collection_items. Examples: query='meteoschweiz', 'swissalti3d', 'Lärm'. Omit query to page through all collections.

tools.name: get_geodata_collection_items
tools.description: List the items (tiles, stations, time slices) of a data.geo.admin.ch STAC collection with their downloadable assets (href, media type, size), plus collection-level assets (e.g. MeteoSwiss station/parameter metadata CSVs). Filter by WGS84 bbox, datetime or a single item id; asset_filter narrows asset keys. Examples: collection='ch.meteoschweiz.ogd-smn', item_id='ber' (Bern-Zollikofen station), asset_filter='_d_' (daily data); collection='ch.swisstopo.swissalti3d', bbox=[7.43,46.94,7.46,46.96]. Next: read_geodata_asset on a CSV/JSON href.

tools.name: read_geodata_asset
tools.description: Download a CSV or JSON asset from data.geo.admin.ch (href from get_geodata_collection_items) and return it as rows you can filter, sort and page — e.g. MeteoSwiss SwissMetNet station files. Filters: where={column: value} (exact), '~text' (substring), '>n'/'<n' (numeric). tail=true returns the latest rows of a time series. Example: url='https://data.geo.admin.ch/ch.meteoschweiz.ogd-smn/ber/ogd-smn_ber_d_recent.csv', tail=true, limit=7, columns=['reference_timestamp','tre200d0','rre150d0']. Large historical files may exceed max_mb — prefer '_recent' or '_now' files.

tools.name: find_data
tools.description: START HERE for any Swiss data question not obviously covered by a specific tool. Searches all connected catalogues at once — opendata.swiss (12'000+ datasets), the federal geodata layers (geo.admin.ch, ~900 layers + STAC), BFS STAT-TAB statistical tables, LINDAS statistical cubes, cantonal/SBB/Swiss Post Opendatasoft portals, SNB data — and returns ranked hits. Every hit includes `next`: the exact tool and arguments that fetch the actual data (invoke it directly, or via call_tool if that tool isn't loaded). Example queries: 'rent prices Zürich', 'Strassenlärm', 'Übernachtungen Hotels', 'parking Basel', 'Radon'. German terms often match best.

tools.name: find_tools
tools.description: Keyword search over all Swissyphus tools this server exposes (with the 'discovery' preset: every module, loaded or not). Returns tool names, what they do, and whether they are loaded. Use describe_tool for the argument schema and call_tool to invoke a tool that is not loaded. Example: 'avalanche danger', 'company VAT', 'train delays', 'court decision'.

tools.name: describe_tool
tools.description: Full description and JSON Schema of the arguments of any Swissyphus tool this server exposes, for use with call_tool.

tools.name: call_tool
tools.description: Invoke any Swissyphus tool this server exposes by name — with the 'discovery' preset that includes every module, so the context stays small while the full catalogue is reachable. Arguments are validated against the tool's schema (see describe_tool). Returns exactly what the tool returns.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: The machine-readable register of every data source behind the active Swissyphus modules: operator, licence, attribution string, update frequency, cache TTL and caveats (RFP-grade source governance).

tools.name: check_source_health
tools.description: Ping every upstream Swiss data source behind the active modules and report status and latency — Swissyphus's built-in status page. Use when another tool reports a source as unavailable.

tools.name: about_swissyphus
tools.description: Orientation for agents: lists the active modules, what each covers, and example questions each can answer. Call this first if unsure which tool fits a Swiss data question.

preset.title: Module preset
preset.description: Which bundle of tools to load. One of: minimal, commuter, outdoor, business, citizen, legal, compliance, discovery, full. 'full' loads every module; the smaller presets save context window.
